coordinates.note: The collaboration papers give 11.4 N, 76.7 E, i.e. to 0.1 degree (about 10 km). No source read gives a finer position, so this is a region-grade point shown as approximate; 8 km is the rounding half-width. The glyph after each number is the arXiv HTML rendering of the degree sign.
coordinates.quote: GRAPES-3 is a ground-based observatory located in the Nilgiri mountains in Ooty, India (11.4∘N, 76.7∘E, 2200 m above mean sea level).

summary.plain: A mountain site near Ooty in the Nilgiri hills of southern India, 2200 metres up, with a field of 400 scintillator detectors and a large muon telescope for cosmic-ray research.
summary.technical: GRAPES-3 site at Ooty, Tamil Nadu (11.4 N, 76.7 E, 2200 m a.s.l.): 400 scintillators over 25000 m2 and a 560 m2 tracking muon telescope; near-equatorial location.
